events.title: Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential implications for global oil prices and geopolitical stability. The situation is being closely monitored by investors and policymakers. The US has imposed new sanctions on Iran, while Iran has threatened to retaliate.
events.reasoning: The escalating conflict between the US and Iran has the potential to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to higher prices and increased volatility in the energy sector. Investors may want to consider buying the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) as a hedge against potential losses in the energy sector, while shorting the VanEck Vectors Oil Services ETF (OIH) to profit from potential declines in oil prices.

timeFrame.note: Monitor US-Iran relations and adjust position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Close position if US-Iran conflict de-escalates or if oil prices decline significantly
